scope: Proposition 3.8 (Buffered scale-change intervals) of the manuscript “Bounded scalar curvature and smooth extension of four-dimensional Ricci flow” (preprints/Bounded-scalar-curvature-and-smooth-extension-of-four-dimensional-Ricci-flow-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 351 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 95655c4053c94f2b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 23-24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: If a concentration point exists, there are parabolically rescaled intervals I = [−θ, 1 + θ], for one fixed θ > 0, with physical squared length 23 units di → 0, such that the root scale throughout I is comparable to a number ai → 0 and changes by a fixed factor between 0 and 1. Put ϵi = √ di. In these units |R| ≤ Cϵ2 i , | Ric |k,r ≤ Ckϵi/r at regularity scales r in a bounded range. For ai ≪ r ≲ 1 the cluster has flat quotient annular limits with nontrivial group. At any fixed time, allowable root centers differ by O(ai).
